body:
MAINLINE-064 is filed. A published knockdown does not close any cell. Sandwich gamma is CR-1457 0.20 for hemispheres at Vc below 2, admissible with a named limit: a 1969 floor from two 1964 aluminum-face glass-honeycomb 55-inch points, not bonded beryllium on CR-III, not a closed 20-30 m sphere, amplitude and specimen Vc unreported. The favorable ramp (0.594-0.604) is not admissible. Gamma is that point, not a range or an amplitude function. 10.2514/3.5568 and 10.2514/3.1932 are not sphere tests.

simjob simjob-20261020t170832-d919922bc1af exited 0. Gamma held at 0.20, other inputs endpoint, Q 0.82 and 0.33. Every concept and TRL 7 payload is negative. QUESTIONABLE. PROJECTION. No qualified hull safety factor. Face starts at 1850 kg/m3.

Q 0.82, Vc 1.04-1.07. R20 ISA: factor 1.527, concept -12.4 t, TRL 7 -7.8 t, closure 1211 kg/m3. R20 optimistic: 1.605, -13.9 t, -9.2 t, 1153. R30 ISA: 1.495, -40.2 t, -25.0 t, 1238. R30 optimistic: 1.570, -45.2 t, -29.7 t, 1178.

Q 0.33 leaves Vc 0.9-1.1 (optima 1.60-1.64). Gamma stays 0.20. Face wrinkling binds. R20 ISA: 2.118, -29.4 t, -23.3 t, 873. R20 optimistic: 2.221, -31.3 t, -25.1 t, 833. R30 ISA: 2.080, -97.9 t, -77.6 t, 889. R30 optimistic: 2.181, -104.4 t, -83.8 t, 848.

063's ramp has positive TRL 7 at R20 ISA and both R30 weathers, only while the ramp is used.

T7 must measure this product form at Vc 0.9-1.1, external pressure, elastic, amplitude, ribbon and cure recorded, and show whether gamma can stand above 0.20. Until then P2 carries 0.20.
